about: Terra Firma watch face: EarthTurn's map held still with the Home meridian straight down, the 24-hour ring and the night turning round it. Same grid, projection, night masks and map images as earthturn.json (assets/web-earthturn, with its date line recoloured); this file holds what differs. Angles are degrees clockwise from straight up. Generated by tools/web/EarthTurnWeb.java from the face's generator.

holds: night mask (plus the equation of time, as earthturn.json)

frames.note: the whole EarthTurn picture turned clockwise by homeLon + utcMinutesOfDay / 4: its map angle 180 - m/4 becomes 180 + homeLon, its fixed sun frame becomes homeLon + m/4; homeLon is the Home city's longitude from dots in earthturn.json, east positive

ring.vintageWeight: bold: the ink drawn at nine spots of a 1 px grid with a paper halo 2 to 3 px out; the time block the same (2026-11-05)

moon.spotsNote: screen angle clockwise from up of each option, 15 degrees an hour with 12 at the top; 10..14 are not offered (the time block)
moon.images: moon/moon_p0.png .. moon_p29.png (78 px, the disc 0.8 of the image), index floor(days since new moon) as [MOON_PHASE_POSITION]; drawn boxPx wide over a paper ring at alpha 0x90 and a night-blue disc

marks.note: drawn zone 1, zone 2, home; the zone bars' outer thirds white
